metadata.description: Common JSON problem-details envelope for structured HTTP failures. `ApiError` emits it for 400, 401, 403, 404 and 500; the rate-limit middleware emits the same four required members for 429; quarantine refusals add `unavailable`. Source of truth: `crates/vibe-index/src/server/error.rs` (`ApiError`, private `Body`) and `crates/vibe-index/src/server/mod.rs` (`rate_limited_response`); the generated reader lives in `crates/vibe-wire/src/generated/index_http/e1/error_response/`.

Stable problem kind such as `vibe-index/error/not-found`, `.../unavailable` or `.../rate-limited`. A string rather than a closed enum: adding a new error kind must remain readable by older raw parsers.
Short human-readable problem title selected by the server error constructor.
HTTP status code repeated in the body (400, 401, 403, 404, 429 or 500 today).
Request-specific explanation and, where applicable, a fix surface.
The full refused-version row on `vibe-index/error/unavailable`; absent on every other problem kind.
One package version this build refuses and the recovery recipe, mirroring `crates/vibe-index/src/index/quarantine.rs::Unavailable`.
The refused version's bare package name.
Reader capabilities unknown to this build, in record order.
The generated explanation and fix surface for the refusal.
